description:
As a registered customer
  I want secure and reliable access to my account
  So that I can manage my personal details and use the web shop's shopping features

elements.name: Grant account access to a registered customer with valid credentials

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the login form from the header
I authenticate using a registered customer's "email" and valid password
access to the customer account should be granted
the authenticated customer's identity should be displayed in the header

elements.name: Protect customer accounts against invalid authentication attempts

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the login form from the header
I attempt to authenticate using my configured email and password "WrongPassword123!"
access to the customer account should be denied
an appropriate authentication error should be displayed
the customer should remain unauthenticated

elements.name: Protect customer accounts against invalid authentication attempts

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the login form from the header
I attempt to authenticate using my configured email and password "InvalidCredential456!"
access to the customer account should be denied
an appropriate authentication error should be displayed
the customer should remain unauthenticated

elements.name: Allow a customer to access the password recovery process

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the login form from the header
I open the forgot password form
the password recovery form should be displayed
the customer should be able to provide their registered email address

elements.name: Submit a password recovery request for a registered customer

steps.name: I am on the web shop home page
I open the password recovery form
I submit my configured test email address for password recovery
the password recovery request should be acknowledged
the customer should receive appropriate next-step guidance

name: Customer authentication and account access
